sloka: भरताय महा राजो यौवराज्यम् प्रयच्चति ।माम् पुनर् दण्डक अरण्यम् विवासयति तापसम् ॥२-२०-३०॥
transliteration: bharatāya mahā rājo yauvarājyam prayaccati ।mām punar daṇḍaka araṇyam vivāsayati tāpasam ॥2-20-30॥

translations.english: The great king is conferring the status of heirapparent on Bharata while he is banishing me to Dandaka forest to live like an ascetic.
